task.instruction: Plan quality coverage for a checkout product spanning many payment paths and one revenue-critical recovery flow.
task.deliverable: A test plan, invariant money-integrity assertion, and supporting evidence.

evidence.content: Synthetic reconciliation records show that a lost acknowledgement can trigger a second processor capture for a completed checkout; accounting policy requires that event to be flagged before settlement.
The interrupted-payment recovery flow represents 9% of attempts but 63% of observed duplicate-charge risk.
A synthetic inventory lists 26 payment paths across device, currency, and retry combinations; 18 have only smoke coverage.

A.content: When coverage is the limiting need, represent the important range of cases before adding detail to any one case.

B.content: When understanding is the limiting need, examine the pivotal case deeply before extending coverage.

irrelevant.content: Use consistent spacing between sections in the final artifact.
